cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Close It Properly
cards.instruction: Keep them present until both of you complete the ritual that formally ends this role, meeting, or relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before you hand in your shop keys, we do the farewell bell. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm leaving because the bell rings constantly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Precisely. This is the last one you have to answer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We ring it together. Leaving is still a team activity.

mechanism: A supervises job departure and muffles the disliked bell while still needing the leaver physically to share the farewell ring before keys transfer.
confusable: Unlike any final goodbye, the shared ritual action is the condition for formally ending the role.
comparison: A jointly rung muted bell differs from book-club spoken reply in a taxi.
seedUse: D170-b shop keys, disliked bell and joint ring; S02-b reduces the nuisance to retain participation.
